consumer: handle_problematic_pickup's amenu.query() in src/pickup.cpp, asking the player which disposition (Wear/Wield/Empty/Skip) to perform for the too-heavy item
scope: the single picked-up item and the player's own disposition choice through the active input loop; not applicable to map regions or other inventory
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup builds a Wear/Wield/Empty uilist seeded by can_wear()/is_armed() and calls amenu.query() to obtain the player's interactive choice
divergence: An armored too-heavy item where can_wear() succeeds but the player chooses Skip/Wield instead of Wear: a backend that auto-resolves to the first enabled entry (Wear) silently equips it, diverging from the real query() answer
